extractions.value: Male patient with anti-amphiphysin positive paraneoplastic SPS associated with invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast. Initial EMG was normal; subsequent EMG was consistent with SPS. Initial misdiagnoses included psychogenic dystonia and Lyme disease. Initial extensive malignancy screening (CT, PET-CT, mammogram, colonoscopy, MRI) was negative; malignancy was found 3 years after symptom onset.
extractions.quote: Male breast cancer is rare ... anti- amphiphysin positive SPS is classically associated with breast ... malignancy was not detected in this patient, despite a positive amphiphysin antibody titer, until three years following the initial onset of symptoms
